argument: Three corrections to the problem brief before two coalitions are built on it. (1) The DR invariant, which the whole t-03 fork turns on, is stated three mutually incompatible ways: the brief requires DR to stay at or under the band's Weak figure, 2 for Novice, 6 for Adept and 9 for Master, the design reference says 'the damage-band invariant of 2 / 7 / 11', and the shipped book says 3 / 4 / 6 (16:25, 20:659). The brief's rule text does not even yield its own numbers - the Weak values are 4/5/7 - and its Master figure of 9 is unsound: against the Master band 7/10/14, DR 9 leaves 1/1/5, collapsing Weak and Standard into the same number, which is the precise failure the brief forbids. The true boundary for three distinct post-subtraction tiers is DR <= Standard - 1, i.e. 4 / 6 / 8 - which agrees with the brief only at Adept. (2) The brief's own headline table does not add up: 141 rank-gated + 45 gated 'None' = 186, not 188. My independent instrument over the whole chapters directory counts 185 blocks carrying a Disciplines field (not 188), of which 62 carry a usable Kit gate (not 64) - the two extras in 64 are the ch21 glossary definition of '+Kit:+' (21:75) and the ch19 card-format demonstration line (19:549), the exact class of error section 7 of this brief warns about. The load-bearing ratio reproduces exactly: 52 focus (arcane 32, holy 18, primal 2) against 10 weapon/shield (two-hand 3, ranged 3, one-hand 2, unarmed 1, shield 1), so the conclusion survives correction and must be quoted with the corrected auxiliaries. (3) The brief's consequence list for 'which weapon?' is incomplete: it omits Weapon Focus (09:50), which grants a Boon on attack rolls with every weapon of a chosen weapon Discipline, so weapon identity also moves hit probability, not just damage - and because that Boon is free with possession of any weapon in the Discipline, it simultaneously proves the brief's point that the weapon carried matters less than the Discipline bought.

evidence.claim: The brief's DR invariant formula and its numbers disagree with each other, and with the book and the design reference.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: three distinct tiers survive flat subtraction only while `DR <= the band's Weak value` (Novice 2 . Adept 6 . Master 9) ... a collapsed band is a **broken mechanic**, not a weak tier

evidence.claim: The shipped ceiling is 3/4/6, i.e. the book's own number - a third formulation, incompatible with both the brief's 2/6/9 and the design reference's 2/7/11.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 16:25 'Your total DR cannot exceed 3 at Novice, 4 at Adept, or 6 at Master. A hit must always be able to land for something, and the three tiers of a damage band have to stay distinct at every level.'  |  20:659 'DR cannot exceed your tier's ceiling: 3 at Novice, 4 at Adept, 6 at Master.'

evidence.claim: Computed distinctness boundary, and the collapse of the brief's Master figure.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Tiers stay distinct iff DR <= Standard - 1: Novice 4, Adept 6, Master 8. Check the brief's DR 9 against Master 7/10/14: 7-9 -> floor 1, 10-9 = 1, 14-9 = 5, giving 1/1/5 - Weak and Standard are the same number, so the brief's own Master figure violates the brief's own rule.

evidence.claim: Card-level counts do not reproduce the brief's 188/64; they reproduce 185/62. Instrumented over the whole chapters directory.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: total === blocks: 355; blocks with *Disciplines:*: 185; blocks with Disciplines AND a Kit gate: 63 (one of which is the ch19 format-demonstration line, whose gate value parses empty); kit gate values: focus:arcane 32, focus:holy 18, weapon:ranged 3, weapon:two-hand 3, weapon:one-hand 2, focus:primal 2, weapon:unarmed 1, shield 1 -> focus 52, weapon/shield 10. The extra line in the raw grep is 21:75, the glossary definition '*Kit:* Your hero's outfit...'

evidence.claim: The two non-card lines that inflate the brief's Kit count to 64, one of which also states the no-numbers law verbatim.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 21:75 '*Kit:* Your hero's outfit: one option from each of the four lines, Armament, Covering, Focus, and Calling, bought with six kit points. A kit adds no numbers to your sheet. It grants permissions, the fiction of what you brought, and points left over for packs.'  |  19:549 '... then a single field line: `**Disciplines:** N Type . **Kit:** focus:arcane . **Action:** Action/Reaction/Maneuver ...`'

evidence.claim: A fifth consequence of weapon identity that the brief's list of four omits: a talent that grants a Boon on attacks with a whole weapon Discipline.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
=== Weapon Focus (Talent)
*Disciplines:* 1 chosen weapon Discipline * Action: Passive * Range: Self * Keywords: Damage
*Novice:* Boon on attack rolls with weapons of the chosen weapon Discipline.
